content:
We open sourced a repo that collects proofs around cryptids:

https://github.com/google-deepmind/cryptids

So far it contains

  • three cryptids for Riemann, Goldbach and ZFC with a small number of states, including proofs that "Machine halts \iff \not "
  • some Collatz like reductions for 6-state 2-symbol machines from the BB(6) holdouts.

We plan to collect more about cryptids, and proofs for (non)-halting here.

Contributions are most welcome!
